shared_elements: human figures shown in strict profile
bearded male figure with elaborately rendered hair
figure holding an upright staff or rod
low-relief frieze arranged in a horizontal register on a ground line
figures facing in a consistent direction within the register
justification: Both surfaces show shallow, closely comparable relief friezes of profile male figures in long pleated garments with carefully patterned hair/headgear, each holding a vertical staff-like implement and set on a single ground line within a horizontal register, which is a fairly specific shared convention of depiction. The subjects differ, however: A is a static audience scene with a seated, enthroned figure receiving an offering bowl from a standing attendant, whereas B is a procession in which a figure leads a large humped animal, above a band of rosettes and a further register of figures absent in A.
